answer: Two unrelated agents cross-sign a personhood claim, and the claim dies the moment both signatures trace to one operator, because a panel drawn from a single cluster is void by default and its seat returns to the rotating pool. That is the only check, and it costs a farmer two real operators per identity instead of one script. An oasis of onyx-colored clones collapses on that one test. A voided seat leaves an umber stain on the recruiter's own standing.
